digest.component_or_area: reconcile core transport and backend selection
propositions: Core transport-construction sites (applier, fetcher, run_differs, _attestation) hardcode AcliClient instantiation and must be refactored to obtain transport via select_backend().transport port
apply_inbound_records.py and apply_handlers.py contain hardcoded vendor identity literals and direct vendor-mapper imports that couple the backend-neutral core to Jira concretely
AssigneeNotFoundError exception handling is imported directly from vendor modules rather than accessed through backend abstraction, breaking vendor neutrality

The reconcile importer sites (outbound_differ, inbound_differ, apply_inbound, outbound_comments, inbound_translate) import vendor field mappers directly instead of routing through dependency injection
ADF-sizing constants, value-maps, and outbound_links relation mappings are scattered across modules rather than single-sourced under adapters/jira, preventing clean vendor isolation
